forbidden_additions: Either review suffices, invented feedback or causation, actual authorization to publish.
must_preserve: Parallel tracks; publication requires BOTH completed reviews; no promise that publication occurs.

ambiguities.note: Both is declared to refer to the named safety and security reviews. Source interpretation is unproved; completion does not mean approval or passage.

cases.source: The safety review and the security review run in parallel. Publication is permitted only after both reviews have completed.

forbidden_additions: Duty for every request without qualification.
A changed or newly generated identifier, reversed ordering, or invented deadline.
Claim that any gateway execution complied.
must_preserve: Retry-marker qualification scopes the first obligation.
Acknowledgement sending precedes request-buffer release; this is not a timed deadline.
Acknowledgement copies the corresponding request identifier unchanged.
The explicit absence of a stated response deadline remains absence, not zero.
Both separate obligations and the final documentary sentence remain recoverable.

ambiguities.note: For is interpreted as applying to each matching request in the declared specification scope, not as proof of an observed request or automatic natural-language quantification.
Identifier equality/representation is unspecified by the source. No bytewise comparator, normalization, conversion or destination wire field is inferred.
The mention is declared to refer to the same acknowledgement role as the send obligation for this request. No actual message identity or unique output count is proved.

cases.source: For a request carrying the retry marker, Gateway G must send an acknowledgement before it releases the request buffer. The acknowledgement must copy the request identifier unchanged. No response deadline is stated.
